limitations: P01 attempt-01 RF01 is closed. DeleteTenant now removes ScanRecords only after save_with accepts the deletion. The added production dispatch/observe regression preserves settled, running and queued records on storage refusal, verifies cancellation and retained outcomes, then verifies successful deletion and no replay. I independently ran the existing sync_scan executable: all 17 tests passed, including this regression. The mutation script and recorded failing guard/passing baseline were inspected, not rerun in the reviewed checkout.

All four fingerprints were independently recomputed and matched. All 79 packet references, recorded tool binaries, command-log hashes, fixture executable/bundle and production app/DMG hashes were verified. C01–C03 receipts, raw-output hashes, completion entries and commit ancestry agree. This establishes retained-byte consistency, not cryptographic proof of provider authorship.

The complete current-input phase runs passed. Retained results include 42 controller, 12 IPC, 5 permission-manifest, 6 Keychain, 164 SDK, 26 core-library, 44 context, 17 scan, 72 desktop frontend and 207 shared presentation tests. Targeted frontend runs overlap the 72-test total. OS Keychain and SDK results were inspected without independently rerunning credential-access tests.

All 38 required native checks are present, passing and merged verbatim from member records naming the same rebuilt fixture executable and host. Native evidence and drivers were inspected; I did not independently launch the GUI. Rendered captures use WKWebView snapshots and native controls use AX. Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; sampled startup socket observations can miss brief connections or unattributed DNS. Offline uses a stopped synthetic endpoint; v1 preservation uses metadata comparisons.

Recomputed budgets pass with registered sample counts: cold-shell p95 590.504 ms, warm-shell p95 353.597 ms, input proxy p95 21.543 ms, idle maximum 208.828 MiB, scan maximum 314.375 MiB, production app 15.992 MiB and DMG 5.973 MiB. Input timing uses accessible-value timing plus an assumed frame, OS file caches remain, and summed RSS may count shared pages repeatedly. Footprint artifacts are unsigned.

The acknowledged version-3 budget method and retained earlier failures remain applicable. Passing its paste-like scan workload does not resolve or waive the C24 long typed-input/assistive-client memory observation. Live qualification, signing, notarization and installed-package acceptance remain C25/C26 work.

This verdict covers the integrated P01 foundation, not future feature implementation or release readiness. Application source was not changed, no product endpoints were called and no real credentials were accessed during this review.
